elements.name: q_1
elements.title: What width applies to vertically scrolling content?
elements.feedback: The criterion specifies a width equivalent to 320 CSS pixels.

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: Can a layout requiring two dimensions for meaning be excepted?
elements.feedback: The exception concerns content requiring two-dimensional layout for usage or meaning.

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: Does an excepted map exempt the entire page?
elements.feedback: The surrounding content must still be evaluated.
